public_definitions: The goal is to identify the clean-generation source with the largest contribution and route it to priority contribution review.
The routing threshold is implied to be the largest contribution source, as sources not meeting this threshold are to be left out of the priority queue.
The dashboard is the source for determining the largest contribution source.
The options are: 'Route Utility solar to priority contribution review', 'Route Offshore wind to priority contribution review', and 'Keep Hydro storage in routine source monitoring'.
